title: Why remote work is dying and nobody wants to admit it

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Did you know remote work is collapsing faster than you think?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Companies are cutting remote jobs by 30% in 2024 — and it’s not just a trend.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Remote work isn’t dead — it’s just not working for most employees anymore.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The biggest issue? Lack of collaboration tools that actually work across time zones.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Teams using hybrid models are 25% more productive than fully remote ones.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The real problem is loneliness and burnout — no one’s talking about it.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: So, are you ready to rethink how we work — or just keep pretending it’s fine?
